_comment: The L4 rehearsal of the P2 runner (scripts/t61_rehearsal.py; docs/launch_cards/t61_rehearsal_l4.md). EXPLORATORY: no row it produces enters training, the floors or any claim. pairing is P1 because the card is P1's (L4) and the values are T3.1's working values (fill_working_values); the session's own pairing is P2-R. The grid is reduced to 2048 and 8192 at batch 1; the measurement protocol (reps, warm-ups, reruns, the sampler, the traced pass) is the working values', unchanged. The grid is cut to density 0.25 for the oracle and mean-pool (the working 0.5 dropped) to keep the card's cap under the adviser's 400 with scope (v); reps, warm-up, rounds and the rest of the protocol are the working values'.
